title: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 2008

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 2008
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXV OF 2011
ACT XXV OF 2011
SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND
SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2008
An Act to further amend the Sindh
Boards of Intermediate
and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
15th July, 2011]
No.PAS/Legisl-B-06/2008, dated 15-7-2011.---The
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education
(Amendment) Bill, 2008 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th July, 2011 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 14th July, 2011 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to further amend the Sindh Boards of
Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
